description: A board's team roles — what people do on its team, «Sound engineer», «Electrician» — each with 'needsApproval' (marked by a person for themselves, it waits for an administrator's yes), its holders in the order an issue for the role reaches them (an issue with the role and nobody on it goes to the first), and who asked for it and waits. Also whether you may change them ('canManage') and mark your own ('canMark'), and your own roles: held and requested.
name: list_team_roles
title: List team roles
